target_customer: Homeowners needing reroofs, roofing contractors and enterprises such as solar installers
problem: Homeowners struggle to find a trusted roofer at a fair price and contractors struggle to find more roofs.
business_model: Managed roofing marketplace and contractor of record with guaranteed price, margin on jobs

founders.name: Doug Barnett
founders.background_notes: YC page: career in sales, sales ops and marketing, most recently marketing at Vivint.

founders.name: Brant Choate
founders.background_notes: YC page: led product at Podium (YC W15) from 1M to 100M ARR.

founders.name: Reno Mendenhall
founders.background_notes: Named as founder in the Cervin Ventures Series A announcement; not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Roofr
competitors.what: Roofing marketplace using satellite imagery for instant estimates, shifting to SaaS for contractors
competitors.funding_then: 8.25 million dollars total after May 2021 post-seed round

technical_complexity.rationale: Quoting, scheduling and contractor management software is standard; operations and contractor quality control are the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Contractor network and homeowner demand give some advantage, but roofing is local and fragmented, with Roofr and others competing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Remi raised a Series A in 2024 and remained independent.

market_need_then: Over 80 million US homes will need new roofs (YC page); Pelion cited 650 percent growth and profitability in the year before the Series A.

identity.voice_and_tone: Trust and guaranteed price messaging with warranties

branding.brand_signature: Guaranteed price roof with licensed contractor
branding.community_and_virality: Claims 500+ five star Google reviews on its own site.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong service messaging and review volume claimed by the company, but no independent press on the brand itself; name shared with Remi Labs and others.

outcome_analysis: Remi raised a 21 million dollar Series A in August 2024 led by Pelion with Cervin, citing 650 percent growth and profitability. The site claims 40,000 projects and 500 five star reviews. No later round or distress was found. Success so far rests on operating a licensed service rather than a pure marketplace.
notes: A 500k YC investment in March 2022 appears only in aggregator snippets, unverified. Revenue 10.5M in 2024 from geo.sig.ai only, unverified. One aggregator lists 23.3M for the Series A, conflicting with 21M from Cervin and Pelion. CB Insights profile mixes Remi (roofing) with Remi Labs (a web3 company where Doug Barnett was also named); founding year conflicts (2021 vs 2022). Cervin page named no competitors; Roofr found by search.
